seed_convention: reset key = jax.random.PRNGKey(seed); raw key at step i = jax.random.fold_in(reset_key, i+1); prospective only.

scripts.scope: Prospective finite replay of actual reset/raw_step states
scripts.intended_objective: Attempt one physical evacuee pickup and shelter delivery while the runner transports a spare lamp and pulses the southern relay; no event has been executed.
scripts.legality_claim: All integers are declared command attempts for active roles. Stop at joint completion and replace no remaining actions; dynamic legality and outcomes have not been executed or certified.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.scope: Paired raw trajectories from the identical reset key and literal shared prefix; replay both suffixes without policy learning.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Only role 0 toggles in branch B. Intended effect: role 1 remains permitted to move west from (6,3) in A, but is blocked in B when no other source lights (5,3). Compare actual positions and visible-cell masks; health contrast is phase-dependent.
zero_or_negative_outcomes: Both rewards can remain the same despite different positions.
No health difference is required; the shadow may not occupy the relevant cell.
If another source illuminates the target or the shared prefix did not reach the intended state, the movement contrast can be zero or indeterminate.
Switching off may save charge and can have a later benefit even while delaying the carrier.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.comparison_rule: Record actual state/observation/action identities and both trajectories. Report intended effects as absent, negative, mixed, failed or indeterminate if that is what execution shows; do not replace the action script after observing a result.
